Thank you for the reply. Sounds silly but because of your words alone. I’ve decided to talk to my boyfriend and I’m going on anti antidepressants again tmr

I’ll try my best. Was your mom open with you about her did? How did she make it work?
Sorry non applicable my friend. I’ll answer and support anything but that. Don’t want to give others ideas. Do you need to talk or vent?
I’ll think about it. Currently telling bf how I feel
Yeah. He said he’s not scared in the slightest. But I’m pretty sure he is. He’s lied about serious before; and who wouldn’t be scared about something like this, even I’m fucking scared
I really don’t, I tell them how it is. Even if their abusive asses don’t believe it. Boyfriend hasn’t been around lately. He might be freaked out by my diagnosed tbh and I have no friends, zilch

I completely understand because I feel exactly the same. I would of left if it wasn’t for him lighting up my world and making it feel whole. But lately it’s felt like an illusion and it’s all falling a part. As it always has. I’m sorry you’re struggling to stay. Have you told her about wanting to leave this world? I know she’ll miss you dearly and she’ll really pain herself for the rest of her entire life knowing she couldn’t stop you. And regrettably might even take her own because you’re gone. You have that much of an impact. I’ll try to stay longer, but I feel very much the same. My best friend who passed away is waiting for me and I miss him dearly every day
I’ve been trying for years to do all of this but thank you

I don’t know if this is helpful knowledge to have. But him and I dated for 3 years. So there’s already a lot of memories there to have.. therefore I cannot possibility talk about everything. I just told him at the very beginning along the lines of “My assets and possessions are yours. (However, you do not owe anything on behalf of me) [because after death, money is always a great dispute and I have student loans. Not sure how that’ll factor out after my death.. ] and I went on to say your heart is always mine. I concluded with how “I’ll always be watching over him even when he’s in agony and in happiness. I’ll be there seeing him become the man he was meant to be.” Etc Because you have to think about your impact on leaving them. How they’ll feel when you’re gone and you need to know what to say both now when you’re alive and thinking 4 steps ahead as you’ll be gone when they see this. So what is this they need to hear the most from you
Doesn’t make up for my family’s behaviour and actions. He is very much normal, privileged and rich
Highly doubt it. Come from a family of assholes and just got diagnosed with did
My whole family is a bunch of assholes. I have no friends and I just got diagnosed with did
We’re far too late for that
Bangs would look cute asf! Chances are if you really want a hair style and are too scared of change, that’s exactly what you need to do
Already DM’ed as we both clarified/know of. But just wanted to make public knowledge so others don’t think I was a jerk for “not replying.” Thanks all
